name: Lin Hao Yu
source:
A protagonist and Davonte's rival. A fiery hot-head who's the self-proclaimed n.1 player in the world.

Major: Biology

Likes: Davonte (but won't admit it), cooking (but won't admit it), video games, sleeping

Dislikes: Effort (more specifically looking like he cares about anything), cats
